name: pg_collate_linux_utf8_calculating_length_match
subject: Fix calculating length of match to localized month/weekday names
goal:
to_date and to_timestamp can consume the wrong number of bytes after matching a localized month or weekday name case-insensitively. In locales where changing case changes the encoded length, the parser advances through the original input by the length of the case-folded text and misreads the fields that follow.

Under a suitable UTF-8 locale, parse Turkish month names in inputs such as `01 Aralık 2010` with `DD TMMONTH YYYY`, including lowercase and reordered variants. Localized names must consume exactly their original input span and produce the intended date. English names, exact-case localized names and unrelated format patterns must remain unchanged.
